IC1: 1. male [OR] or female, age 21 or older,
IC2: 2. diagnosed with definite, probable, [OR] or possible ALS according to the modified El Escorial Criteria,
IC3: 3. a score of 2 or greater on the speech question of the ALSFRS-R (i.e. speech is intelligible with occasional repetition),
IC5: 5. willingness and medical ability to comply with scheduled visits [AND] and study procedures,
IC6: 6. ability to understand the purpose and risks of the study and provide signed and dated informed consent and authorization to use protected health information (PHI) in accordance with national and local subject privacy regulations,
IC8: 8. for the 25 participants in Group 1, [NOT] NO noted symptoms of frontotemporal cognitive dysfunction, [AND] and
IC9: 9. for the 25 participants in Group 2, MUST have cognitive symptoms as noted either by themselves or a caregiver.
